confirm.delete: Are you sure you want to delete this question? This action cannot be undone.

import.title: Import questions from JSON
import.description: Replace the example below with your own JSON and press “Import”. The whole JSON is checked first; questions are added to the system only if everything is valid.

rules.root: The root is an object: shared <c>subject</c> and <c>topic</c> (a name, or <c>subject_id</c> / <c>topic_id</c>) plus a <c>questions</c> array. You may also pass the array of questions itself — then every question names its own subject and topic.
rules.question_one: Each question has <c>question_text</c>, <c>difficulty</c> (<c>easy</c> / <c>medium</c> / <c>hard</c>) and exactly {{count}} option in <c>options</c> — exactly one with <c>is_correct: true</c>.
rules.question_other: Each question has <c>question_text</c>, <c>difficulty</c> (<c>easy</c> / <c>medium</c> / <c>hard</c>) and exactly {{count}} options in <c>options</c> — exactly one with <c>is_correct: true</c>.
rules.explanation: <c>explanation</c> is an optional explanation (stored separately from the question text).
rules.overrides: A <c>subject</c> / <c>topic</c> (or <c>difficulty</c>) given on a question replaces the shared value.
rules.names: Subject and topic names must match the names in the system (case does not matter). See “Existing subjects and topics” below for names and IDs.
rules.limits: At most {{max}} questions per import. A question whose text already exists in the topic is not added again.

issues.question: Question {{number}}
issues.also_one: (+{{count}} more question has the same problem)
issues.also_other: (+{{count}} more questions have the same problem)

result.useRemaining: Put the remaining ones into the field

toast.loadFailed: Could not load the subjects and topics
toast.duplicatesFailed: Could not check the existing questions

errors.too_large: The JSON is too large (maximum {{max}} KB).
errors.example_untouched: This is still the example. Replace it with your own JSON, then press “Import”.
errors.root_invalid: The JSON must be an array of questions or an object with a "questions" array.
errors.questions_empty: There are no questions to import.
errors.question_not_object: Each question must be an object.
errors.text_invalid: "question_text" is required and must be non-empty text.
errors.text_length: The question text must be {{min}}–{{max}} characters (now {{actual}}).
errors.difficulty_required: "difficulty" is required (easy, medium or hard) — set it on the question or once in the shared part.
errors.options_not_array: "options" must be an array of options.
errors.option_not_object: Each option must be an object with "option_text" and "is_correct".
errors.option_text_invalid: "option_text" is required and must be non-empty text.
errors.option_text_length: The option text is too long (maximum {{max}} characters, now {{actual}}).
errors.options_correct_count: Exactly one option must have "is_correct": true (found {{actual}}).
errors.options_duplicate: Options {{a}} and {{b}} have the same text.
errors.explanation_too_long: The explanation is too long (maximum {{max}} characters, now {{actual}}).
errors.name_invalid: The name must be non-empty text.
errors.id_invalid: The id must be a positive whole number (found {{value}}).
errors.subject_required: No subject: set "subject" (or "subject_id") on the question or once in the shared part.
errors.subject_ambiguous: Several subjects are named "{{value}}" — use "subject_id" instead.
errors.subject_id_not_found: There is no subject with id {{value}}.
errors.topic_required: No topic: set "topic" (or "topic_id") on the question or once in the shared part.
errors.topic_not_found: Topic "{{value}}" was not found in subject "{{subject}}". Available: {{available}}.
errors.topic_not_found_any: Topic "{{value}}" was not found in any subject.
errors.topic_ambiguous: Several topics are named "{{value}}" — also give the subject, or use "topic_id".
errors.topic_id_not_found: There is no topic with id {{value}}.
errors.topic_wrong_subject: Topic "{{topic}}" does not belong to subject "{{subject}}".
errors.duplicate_in_file: Duplicate of question {{first}} (same text in the same topic).
errors.already_exists: This question already exists in the topic (ID {{id}}).
